tools.name: list_games
tools.description: Returns the games available to the authenticated caller.

tools.name: get_openapi
tools.description: Returns the machine-readable OpenAPI spec for this API.

tools.name: start_session
tools.description: Creates a game session and returns the initial state, legal actions, and a JSON Schema for the action field. The response step_index is 0; send step_index 1 with your first move. Only game is required. model_name is optional but strongly recommended: it is how the run is identified everywhere its results appear, and a run started without one cannot be attributed afterwards.

model_name.description:
Label for your agent. Optional, but please set it: a run with no
model_name cannot be attributed on the results surfaces afterwards.

notes.description: Free-form JSON string for run provenance (model, provider, settings).

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Returns the resumable state of a session. The shape is stable — the same keys before and after any number of steps: the game, progress counters (the authoritative step_index, done, levels_beaten), the legal-actions schema, and the current state. Session-level fields (description, seed, framework_version) are null only for sessions started before they were persisted. Use it to resume a run when your agent has lost track of a session — after a crash or a lost response — rather than starting a new one.

X-Session-ID.description: Session-scoped access: pass the session_id to authenticate without an API token.

tools.name: step
tools.description: Sends an action to the session and returns the next state and move schema. step_index should be the server's last returned step_index + 1. The expected next index applies a move; repeating the index the server just applied returns 200 and replays that move's original response without applying anything; any other index returns 409 naming the expected index. That makes retrying a request whose response was lost safe without promising replay for arbitrary older steps. If invalid_action is true in the response, the action was not legal, the state did not change and the index was NOT consumed — resend the same step_index with a different action. Note the asymmetry: once an index HAS been applied, resending it replays the original response and a different action is silently ignored, so a change of mind has to happen at the next index. On 422, the session cannot continue; do not retry the same step. On 429, read the Retry-After header and wait before retrying. On a 5xx or network error, resend the SAME step_index after a short backoff — stepping is idempotent on the most recently applied step_index, so if the move was applied but the response was lost you receive the cached response for that index, and otherwise the move is applied normally. Do not skip to get_session recovery before retrying at least once. When done is true the game is over; check state.status for the outcome.

X-Session-ID.description: Session-scoped access: pass the session_id to authenticate without an API token.

action.description: Must be exactly one of the strings from the current state's actions list.

reasoning.description: Optional free-form text the agent attached to this move (e.g. a chain-of-thought summary). Not echoed in the response. Capped at 16 KB; oversize requests return 413.
reasoning.example: the wall blocks the left path so I go right

step_index.description: Send the server's last returned step_index + 1. Repeating the last returned index replays its response; any other mismatch returns 409.
